run_deformable_ball_simulation: run the pybullet deformable ball simulation with a soft body ball, rigid box, and ground plane
create_soft_body_with_neo_hookean: create a soft body using loadSoftBody with Neo-Hookean material parameters for Mu, Lambda, and Damping
configure_deformable_world_simulation: configure a deformable world simulation by calling resetSimulation with RESET_USE_DEFORMABLE_WORLD flag
set_physics_engine_parameters: set physics engine parameters like sparseSdfVoxelSize and timeStep for soft body simulation accuracy
load_urdf_rigid_bodies: load URDF rigid body models like planes and cubes using loadURDF with position and orientation
